deniedWrite.reason: Signed Approval Policy requires 1 human approval before WRITE_LOW. A Pi tool call cannot carry an AMC approval, so AMC denied the action.

deniedBash.reason: Signed ToolHub policy rejected the current process.spawn arguments. Pi tool_call has no verified corrective retry outcome, so AMC denied the action.

unmappedExtensionTool.reason: Pi tool amc_probe_effect is not mapped to an allowed ToolHub tool.

codemode.reason: Pi tool codemode is not mapped to an allowed ToolHub tool.

latencyMs.measured: extension tool_call handler to its result: requested observation, control decision, receipt check; loopback Bridge
